content:
I opened the PR: [madsbolaris/trailvault-capture-test#36](https://github.com/madsbolaris/trailvault-capture-test/pull/36).

It adds one file, [visualizations/bouncing-ball.html](visualizations/bouncing-ball.html). That file was already staged in your working tree, so I used it as it was. The page is a single file with no dependencies and animates the ball on a canvas:
- Sliders for gravity and bounciness, plus Pause/Play and Reset buttons.
- Clicking the canvas throws the ball toward that point.
- The ball squashes when it hits the floor, casts a shadow that shrinks as it rises, and leaves a short trail.
- It stays sharp on high-resolution screens, resizes with the window and follows light/dark mode.

**Branch:** I didn't open it from your current branch (`demo/route-search-20261030`), because that branch has 8 route-search commits that aren't on `main`. Instead I made a new branch, `add-bouncing-ball-visualization`, from `origin/main`. The PR contains only this one commit.

The repo has no CI checks, and I didn't open the page in a browser. To check it yourself, open the file directly:

```bash
open visualizations/bouncing-ball.html
```
